propositions: infrastructure exceptions (LLMUnavailableError) at gates must emit an additive verdict=ERROR sidecar record with error.cause and error.evidence_ref to enable passive diagnosis interval tracking without changing existing gate outcomes

plan-review and code-review gates catch LLMUnavailableError and must continue returning degraded INDETERMINATE verdicts while writing the ERROR record; completion gate must write the ERROR record then re-raise the exception to preserve fail-closed behavior
ERROR records use dedicated schema gate_error_v1 with separate build_error_payload builder to bypass reconcile_verdict and prevent ERROR coercion to FAIL on completion path
existing verdict readers (latest_review_result, latest_fail_verdict) must skip gate_error_v1 via schema guards so ERROR records do not pollute verdict queries or gate outcomes
domain-level BLOCK/FAIL exceptions must not emit ERROR records (infra-only scope)
ERROR records are written to existing event types REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT with no new event type introduced
